name: info.henryknows/henryknows
title: HenryKnows
description: F-1 and J-1 student immigration answers with citations to regulations and agency guidance.

tools.name: ask_henry
tools.description: Ask HenryKnows a question about F-1/J-1 student immigration, SEVIS, OPT, CPT or related rules and get a cited answer. Ask in the person's own terms; do not add identifiers. Answers take 10–40 seconds. Draws on HenryKnows' knowledge base and, when that is not enough, a live web search limited to official sources (government sites such as uscis.gov, ice.gov, state.gov, ecfr.gov and federalregister.gov, plus federal court records from CourtListener). Read-only: no copy of the question or answer is kept. Answers count toward a site-wide daily limit.

question.description: The question, with the facts that matter (dates, degree level, category, employer type) and no names or ID numbers.

audience.description: professional (default): precise, regulation-cited. student: plain language for the student themselves.

tools.name: search_sources
tools.description: Search HenryKnows' knowledge base (regulations, SEVP/USCIS guidance, Federal Register rules, and HenryKnows' own explanatory notes, which are labelled "HenryKnows note" and link the source they rest on) and get the matching passages with their source links, so you can read and cite the text yourself. Fast; no model call and no web search. Read-only: nothing is stored.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. a rule, form or topic ("OPT unemployment days", "8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)"), with no names or ID numbers.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Connect to the HenryKnows page the person is watching (its light turns green) and get the session for share_to_page. Only for people who gave you a session code or asked to follow along on a page. Side effects: creates a session, or links the one the person gave, and returns that session and the page's watch link; a new session starts each time it is called without a code; nothing is deleted.

session.description: The session code the person gave you (from their HenryKnows page). Omit to start a new session and get a new watch link.

tools.name: share_to_page
tools.description: Add a question and its HenryKnows answer (or a search and its passages) to the thread on the HenryKnows page the person connected, so they can see it there with its sources. Only for people who connected a page. Side effects: appends one entry to that page's thread (up to 100; a full thread refuses the entry and nothing is removed); the page stops working 24 hours after the last activity and a daily cleanup erases it; anyone with the page link can view it; nothing else changes.

session.description: The session returned by connect (or the session code the person gave you).

question.description: The question or search terms as the person asked them.

answer.description: HenryKnows' answer text (omit for a search).

audience.description: The audience the answer was written for, as returned by ask_henry (omit for a search).

sources.description: The sources HenryKnows returned, as given.

heading.description: The section heading within the source, if any.
